searchText: Hi <@&688090867927482525> , I just built geth from master and synced to Baikal and am using it as a local RPC node. I wanted to replace a txn where the maxFeePerGas is the same, but I multiplied the maxPriorityFeePerGas with 1000. The priority fee is still lower than the max fee per gas, and the network base fee is 7 wei. I get `replacement transaction underpriced` I just replaced it by multiplying maxFeePerGas by 10 To me it seems that the miner only cares about the tip (and of course if the txn can still be included in the block, and what the tip would be in the current block) <@!508125616940515329> Afaik the current master only contains a subset of the changes for 1559, the changes to the txpool are here: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/22898 Ah whoops then disregard my comment 🙂 (might be that replacement is still borked on that branch though^⁾ I won't check now, am focussing tonight to send some funny txs to Baikal 🙂 Yeah you need (one of the) txpool-changes pr(s) Does geth have an internal limit on maxPriorityFeePerGas? I can foresee some problems here, we actually don't have something in the spec which limits the size of maxPriorityFeePerGas... I could foresee that clients cut off the max fee at other points..? There is nothing in the spec which limits me to send a gigantic byte array of maxPriorityFeePerGas It seems I cannot get a txn mined where maxPriorityFeePerGas is `Buffer.from(('ff').repeat(32), 'hex')` and maxFee is just some "normal" number I just got a txn mined where maxPriorityFeePerGas + maxFeePerGas is exactly that buffer value The Geth sealer node does not seem to participate in txpool, which is not nice since it always mines empty blocks, so it is harder to crank up basefee Geth doesn’t allow txs in the mempool with a tip greater than feeCap, that’s probably what you’re seeing Hmm ok I assume this is to somewhat prevent fat-fingered feecaps? I think you mean fat fingered tips? Ah yeah sorry I meant that yeah I have sent a batch of txs with 29M gas limit followed by txs with 1M gas limit; block gas limit is 30M, blocks are not full only one txn gets mined each time. My main motivation was just that txs with tips larger than the fee cap don’t make any sense Unfortunately won’t be around a computer for another 4-5 hours so I can’t help much 😢 It indeed does not but I think it will somewhat prevent people entering tips where they want it to be ~20% of the fee cap, but they instead enter an extra 0 so end up with 200% http://18.224.51.102:3000/tx/0x82d6b028e804f91105d9662f626d4d188050ebfac0765d157e9ca2865b985286 Hehe fun Does breaking block explorer UIs count? 🙂 The txpool/miners dont seem to work so well 😦 Blocks are non full while I have a high queue on pending txs Here's my local geth ``` status: { pending: 178, queued: 203 }, ``` Is it just the geth signer leaving empty blocks? I have not explicitly checked this, but on https://baikal.ethdevops.io/ txpool of the Baikal sealer is always empty, while quilt is not (pending txs) We have 3 signers right? Two signers are somehow not picking up my txs (I am sending them over a local Geth node) while one of them does pick them up and includes them in blocks 🤔 Txs are all the same http://18.224.51.102:3000/block/30274

Hi <@&688090867927482525> , I just built geth from master and synced to Baikal and am using it as a local RPC node. 

I wanted to replace a txn where the maxFeePerGas is the same, but I multiplied the maxPriorityFeePerGas with 1000. The priority fee is still lower than the max fee per gas, and the network base fee is 7 wei. I get `replacement transaction underpriced`

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: I just replaced it by multiplying maxFeePerGas by 10

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: To me it seems that the miner only cares about the tip (and of course if the txn can still be included in the block, and what the tip would be in the current block)
